newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan stocks end flat on new accounts day.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan stocks end flat on new accounts day.

text.p: Pakistani stocks ended flat on Tuesday as a rise in synthetics offset selling by speculators in the index-weighted scrips on the new accounts day, dealers said.
The Karachi 100-share index eased 0.89 points, or 0.06 percent, to end at 1,384.17. Losers led gainers 129 to 116.
"The synthetics sector attracted buyers as polyester staple fibres have gone up in the local and international markets," dealer Sajjad Mankani said.
"But overall trading was dull as investors kept to the sidelines due to political uncertainty."
